title: Orthotists and Prosthetists
description: Design, measure, fit, and adapt orthopedic braces, appliances or prostheses, such as limbs or facial parts for patients with disabling conditions.

tasks.text: Fit, test, and evaluate devices on patients, and make adjustments for proper fit, function, and comfort.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on fitting of prostheses to bodies

dwas.name: Adjust prostheses or other assistive devices.

tasks.text: Instruct patients in the use and care of orthoses and prostheses.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient assistive-equipment instruction is hands-on care

dwas.name: Instruct patients in the use of assistive equipment.

tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

tasks.text: Examine, interview, and measure patients to determine their appliance needs and to identify factors that could affect appliance fit.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Collecting from patients requires live clinical interaction

dwas.name: Collect medical information from patients, family members, or other medical professionals.
Examine patients to assess general physical condition.
Measure the physical or physiological attributes of patients.

tasks.text: Select materials and components to be used, based on device design.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Medical device fabrication is physical manufacturing

tasks.text: Design orthopedic and prosthetic devices, based on physicians' prescriptions and examination and measurement of patients.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI assists concepts; device design requires regulatory and physical testing

tasks.text: Repair, rebuild, and modify prosthetic and orthopedic appliances.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Medical device fabrication is physical manufacturing

dwas.name: Adjust prostheses or other assistive devices.

tasks.text: Construct and fabricate appliances, or supervise others constructing the appliances.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Medical support supervision is live, accountable

tasks.text: Make and modify plaster casts of areas to be fitted with prostheses or orthoses to guide the device construction process.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Medical device fabrication is physical manufacturing

tasks.text: Confer with physicians to formulate specifications and prescriptions for orthopedic or prosthetic devices.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Show and explain orthopedic and prosthetic appliances to healthcare workers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

tasks.text: Train and supervise support staff, such as orthopedic and prosthetic assistants and technicians.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

tasks.text: Update skills and knowledge by attending conferences and seminars.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI summarizes medical updates; human retains judgment

tasks.text: Research new ways to construct and use orthopedic and prosthetic devices.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Literature review aided; wet-lab and clinical research human

dwas.name: Conduct research to increase knowledge about medical issues.

tasks.text: Publish research findings or present them at conferences and seminars.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Medical research presentation needs human delivery
